_comment: Vendored, unmodified, from the npm tarball below: the LHC-Forms web component and its FHIR support library, served from the IG site so a form page makes no request to a CDN at runtime (owner, 2026-10-14). Only the files a page loads are kept (see the package README, 'Using the LHC-Forms Web Component'); source maps are not. LICENSE.md is the package's own and travels with the files, as its terms require for redistribution in binary form. webcomponent/lhc-forms.js, the package's single-file build, is added for the self-hosted NLM Form Builder, which loads exactly that file (and the others here) for its preview; the service worker answers its requests to lhcforms-static.nlm.nih.gov from this directory.
licence: LICENSE.md (NLM owner notice; BSD-style terms; LOINC and UCUM terms where that content is included)
